name: Star Roamer
description: The Star Roamer was a medium freighter manufactured by Damorian Manufacturing Corporation. It was owned by CorDuro Shipping and in 26 ABY was used to deliver a shipment of bacta to the Yuuzhan Vong. They were intrigued by its healing properties, and would later try and sabotage its production using a virus carried by fallen Jedi Bey Gandan.
